author: Telos I
title: AOS Development: Definitive Adapter Test (Legacy Data Fix)
abstract: The definitive test of adapter.py after implementing a fix to handle legacy log data formats. The adapter now safely accesses keys and handles multiple historical schemas. This test will validate the fix and complete Task 22.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
import json

from telos import adapter

TELOS_LOG_PATH = "storage/telos/action_log.json"

print("--- Final, definitive test of adapter.py with legacy data handling ---")
try:
    converted_data = adapter.convert_log_to_schema(TELOS_LOG_PATH)
    
    print("Conversion successful. Verifying output structure...")
    
    assert converted_data["schema"] == "agency_actions"
    assert len(converted_data["actions"]) > 0
    
    print("\n--- Sample of converted actions (first and last) ---")
    print("First entry (legacy format):")
    print(json.dumps(converted_data["actions"][0], indent=2))
    print("\nLast entry (modern format):")
    print(json.dumps(converted_data["actions"][-1], indent=2))
    
    print("\n--- Adapter test DEFINITIVELY PASSED. ---")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"\n--- Adapter test FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY. Error: {e} ---")
